         2                  ACTING PRESIDENT MARCELLINO:    The

         3       Senate will come to order.

         4                  I ask everyone present to rise and

         5       repeat with me the Pledge of Allegiance.

         6                  (Whereupon, the assemblage recited

         7       the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

         8                  ACTING PRESIDENT MARCELLINO:    The

         9       invocation today will be given by the Reverend

        10       Peter G. Young, of the Mother Theresa

        11       Community in Albany.

        12                  REVEREND YOUNG:    Let us pray.

        13                  New Yorkers saw the christening of

        14       the American flag when the Stars and the

        15       Stripes were first flown in battle at the

        16       defense of Fort Stanwick in Rome.

        17                  It's with great pride that we are

        18       able to serve as Senators in this district in

        19       this patriotic tradition as the elected

        20       leaders to fulfill Your call.

        21                  O God, we ask all of these men to

        22       be blessed in their leadership to the citizens

        23       of New York State.

        24                  Amen.

        25                  ACTING PRESIDENT MARCELLINO:
